audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreement: full phases[1-5].side read 'Skill' and phases[6].side reads 'Skill' while content win[1..5] read 'Thresh' and win[6] reads 'Janna'. The full-layer why text never states who wins each row.
audit.why: Thresh out-tempos a squishy, escape-less Janna from level 2 through first item (Hook-Flay threatens a kill every time she steps up), then Janna's Monsoon/Eye of the Storm/Q knockup flip the lane once she has items — exactly what content.whys[1..6] already states.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[1,2,3,4,5].side to 'Thresh' and phases[6].side to 'Janna' (matching win[]), rewrote each .why to state the reason, and adjusted ratings to reflect the swing.

audit.why: Even level 1, Thresh-favored 2 through first item once Flay threatens her lack of escape, Janna-favored late once Monsoon and shields outscale the engage.
Level 2 Flay-Hook kill threat, level 6 Monsoon becomes the counter-engage tool to respect, first item widens Thresh's all-in package, late items flip peel in Janna's favor.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Howling Gale as matchup-defining but carried no cooldown number; report[8].t and report[9].t misgender Janna as 'his/His'.
audit.why: Howling Gale is a flat 14s cooldown. Janna is she/her per champ-gender.js.
audit.corrected: Added the 14s cooldown to breakdown.cooldowns; fixed both pronouns.
